reason: I'd self-host the free version before paying for Cloud, so the $99 isn't for me anyway. And my problem with background agents was never scheduling, it was PRs not worth reviewing, and nothing here says the output gets better.
objection: Passing tests doesn't make a PR good. Pre-alpha from one developer means I'd spend my mornings reviewing junk and babysitting the tool.
would_change_my_mind: A public log of real overnight runs on a real repo with the share of PRs merged without rework, then I'd try the self-hosted version on a side project.
